title: Get Listed on Google - Google Business Profile CA

facts.fact: Google states that its Business Profile is free to set up, with the page headline describing it as a free Business Profile on Google Search and Maps.
facts.quote: Stand out on Google with a free Business Profile

facts.fact: Google claims that businesses can enable 24/7 online booking directly from their Business Profile.
facts.unit: hours a day, 7 days a week
facts.quote: Enable 24/7 online booking directly from your Business Profile.

facts.fact: Creating a Google Business Profile and listing a business on Google is free, according to the page's FAQ.
facts.quote: Yes, creating a Business Profile and listing your business on Google is free.

facts.fact: The page describes getting a free Business Profile as a three-step process: Create, Personalize, and Grow.
facts.quote: Get a free Business Profile in 3 simple steps

facts.fact: In the page's sample performance dashboard for one advertiser, total views were 4,275, and the page states these statistics are specific to that advertiser and individual results may vary.
facts.quote: Performance statistics are specific to this advertiser and individual results may vary.

facts.fact: In the page's sample dashboard, the search term 'cafe' is listed among the keywords used to find the advertiser's business.
facts.quote: Discover what keywords people search to find you
